---
title: "LASH Lab"
subtitle: "Climate, environment, and urban health"
---

We study how climate hazards and environmental exposures (extreme heat, floods, and air pollution) shape health
and health inequities in cities, with a focus on Latin America and Philadelphia. The lab is led by
[Josiah L. Kephart, PhD, MPH](cv.qmd), Assistant Professor of Environmental and Occupational Health at the
Dornsife School of Public Health, Drexel University, and Core Faculty at the Urban Health Collaborative.
